o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bulït. Cognate with Turkish bulut, Yakut былыт (bïlït).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *jogurgan (“blanket”). Analyzable as yor + -ğan. See also Kyrgyz жууркан (juurkan), Southern Altai јууркан (ǰuurkan) and Turkish yorgan.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آغاجرلن (aġacdälän). Present participle compound of ağac (“tree”) + dəlmək (“to drill, peck”).
